cross_product_finding: RECURRENCE of the known anomaly logged in docs-issues/capella-pages-cite-server-versions.json: 'In clusters using Couchbase Server 7.6 and later, you can use the LATERAL keyword as a visual reminder...' Confirms the credential-type/privilege model extends cleanly to JOIN: it names the same Basic->Read / Advanced->Query Read pair as LET and INFER in this same batch, with no requiresCapellaRole gate (JOIN, like INFER, is a data-plane read-only clause, not a management-plane action). Also: this page and keyspace-hints.json (both in this batch) each declare, from their own side, that the inline USE HASH/USE NL join-clause syntax and the USE_HASH/USE_NL hint-comment syntax are 'equivalent' - a genuine isSynonymOf pair, captured on both extraction records so it survives regardless of which page a reconciler reads first.
